topic: Compound interest: your money earns money, and then that money earns money too. The earlier you start, the bigger the snowball (use a simple example).

episode.title: Coin & Kash: The Money Snowball

shots.narration: What if your money’s earnings could earn money too?
shots.scene: Bright modern cafe, vertical 9:16 composition, blank tabletop, clear jar containing gold coins, no text or markings.
shots.action: Kash peers closely into the coin jar.
shots.mood: Curious wide eyes, warm sunlight, bright friendly 3D animation.

shots.narration: Kash thinks only her starting money can earn.
shots.scene: Same cafe table, one large gold coin beside a cluster of smaller gold coins, no text or markings.
shots.action: Kash points only at the large gold coin.
shots.mood: Puzzled expression, gently tilted head, clean pastel surroundings.

shots.narration: [excited] Coin shows an example: start with one hundred dollars.
shots.scene: Cafe tabletop with a clear jar holding ten identical plain gold discs representing the example starting money, no text.
shots.action: Coin presents the jar with an open-handed gesture.
shots.mood: Cheerful teaching moment, shiny gold highlights, attentive Kash.

shots.narration: Imagine it earns ten dollars, which stays with the hundred.
shots.scene: Close view of the same jar and one matching gold disc on the cafe tabletop, no text or markings.
shots.action: Coin drops the extra disc into the jar.
shots.mood: Clear and playful, warm reflections on transparent glass.

shots.narration: Now that earned ten can earn money too.
shots.scene: Cafe tabletop, clear jar of gold discs, newest disc glowing softly beside a tiny gold bead, no text.
shots.action: The glowing disc produces a tiny floating gold bead.
shots.mood: Magical illustrative glow, Kash's delighted expression, uncluttered 3D styling.

shots.narration: [chuckles] Earnings earning more earnings: that’s compound interest.
shots.scene: Cafe table with the coin jar beside a miniature snowy slope and a small snowball, no text.
shots.action: Coin rolls the snowball down the miniature slope.
shots.mood: Playful demonstration, soft white snow, bright gold accents.

shots.narration: Like this snowball, growth builds on what’s already there.
shots.scene: Miniature snowy slope across the cafe table, snowball surrounded by loose snow, no text or markings.
shots.action: The rolling snowball gathers snow into a larger ball.
shots.mood: Satisfying visible growth, rounded shapes, friendly animated wonder.

shots.narration: Starting earlier gives our example snowball more time to grow.
shots.scene: Two parallel miniature snow tracks, one long and one short, with a larger snowball below the long track and a smaller one below the short track, no text.
shots.action: Coin traces the longer track with one tiny hand.
shots.mood: Clear visual comparison, thoughtful Kash, soft blue and gold palette.

shots.narration: [excited] Today, draw your snowball; next, we’ll explore saving habits!
shots.scene: Cafe table with Kash's open unmarked notebook, pencil, and a small empty jar, vertical 9:16 frame, no letters or numbers.
shots.action: Kash draws a simple snowball picture in her notebook.
shots.mood: Encouraging finish, cheerful Coin, cozy sunlight and bright mustard accents.

episode.description: Coin helps Kash picture compound interest as a growing snowball: money earns money, and those earnings can earn money too. Follow a simple hypothetical example, then sketch your own money snowball.
